items.title: Reachable block decomposition and same-field state-feedback pole placement
items.statement: For finite real or complex A,B, constructs the reachable block decomposition, identifies PBH rank failure exactly with the uncontrollable spectrum, and assigns arbitrary same-field pole lists on reachable pairs by a complete multi-input invariant-line/quotient induction.

items.title: Closed-region PBH rank tests characterize continuous and discrete stabilizability and detectability
items.statement: For finite real or complex matrices, proves both directions of the continuous and discrete stabilizability and detectability PBH tests over complex spectral parameters, including Re(lambda)=0 and |lambda|=1, with feedback and injection witnesses in the original field.
